events.title: The new year begins with 맨체스터 유나이티드 still 12 points ahead at the top of the Premier League after a goalless draw at home to Leeds. 블랙번 로버스 narrowly eat in their lead with a 1–0 win at 애스턴 빌라. The key action in Division One includes a 4-2 for Bolton over 노츠 카운티 at Burnden Park , while 밀월 keep up their promotion push with a 3–0 home win over London rivals 크리스털 팰리스 and 사우스엔드 유나이티드 keep hold of their place in the top six with a 3–1 home win over 버밍엄 시티.

첼시 climb five points clear of the relegation zone with a 4–2 home win over 에버턴. 더비 카운티 keep their push for a playoff place on track with a 4–0 home win over 트랜미어 로버스, who lose their place in the top two to Charlton, who win 2–1 at home to 웨스트브로미치 앨비언.
After taking a 3–0 lead in the first half, 맨체스터 유나이티드 are held to a 3–3 draw by 리버풀 in the league at Anfield .
It is reported in the media that the former 토트넘 홋스퍼 manager 테리 베너블스 will take over as manager of the England team.

The FA Cup third round sparks some major upsets. 브리스틀 시티 hold 리버풀 to a 1–1 draw, while an identical scoreline occurs for 에버턴 at 볼턴 원더러스. 퀸스 파크 레인저스 are defeated by 스톡포트 카운티 , but the big shock comes when Division One 버밍엄 시티 lose 2–1 at home to Conference leaders Kidderminster Harriers . 첼시 were surprised to be held 0–0 at Stamford Bridge by 바닛 , despite it being 바닛's 'home' tie. 바닛 had been struggling at the bottom of the third tier for the entire season, having seen most of their squad and manager leave for 사우스엔드 유나이티드, who they ironically knocked out of the season's League Cup. The match against 첼시 was billed as Hoddle vs Hoddle, as Glenn managed 첼시, whilst his brother, Carl , had scored a Hoddlesque goal for 바닛 versus 크롤리 타운 in the 2nd Round.

Ian Branfoot resigns after two and a half years as manager of 사우샘프턴, with former England manager 그레이엄 테일러 rumoured to be on the shortlist of possible successors. 셰필드 웬즈데이 beat 윔블던 2–1 in the League Cup quarter-final. 테리 버처 sues 코번트리 시티 for £40,000 after his fourteen-month spell as player-manager was ended in January 1992.

맨체스터 유나이티드 are held to a 2–2 draw in the League Cup quarter-final against 포츠머스 at Old Trafford, with Paul Walsh scoring twice for 포츠머스 to force a replay. 애스턴 빌라 beat 토트넘 홋스퍼 2–1 at White Hart Lane in their quarter-final clash.
알렉스 퍼거슨 sells his son, midfielder Darren Ferguson , from 맨체스터 유나이티드 to 울버햄프턴 원더러스 for £250,000.

Mike Walker , the manager who took 노리치 시티 to a club best of third place in the Premier League last season, departs Carrow Road to take over at 에버턴. 노리치 시티 announce that Walker's assistant, John Deehan will succeed him as manager with immediate effect, and that the club will be taking legal action against 에버턴 for "tapping up" Walker.
Manager Issy ten Donkelaar is fired by Netherlands club 트벤터 , and replaced by Hans Meyer from Germany.

Mike Walker starts on a high at 에버턴, guiding them to a 6–2 home win over Premier League basement club 스윈던 타운, in which Tony Cottee scores his second league hat-trick of the season. 애스턴 빌라 beat 웨스트햄 유나이티드 3–1 at Villa Park and 리버풀 win 3–0 at Oldham. In Division One, a relegation crunch game at Vicarage Road sees 왓퍼드 beat Birmingham 5–2, with Paul Furlong scoring a hat-trick.

에르빈 쿠만 plays his last international match for the Netherlands national team , replacing 데니스 베르흐캄프 in the second half of the friendly match in and against Tunisia (2–2). It is the 500th match in history of the Netherlands national team.
맨체스터 유나이티드 beat 에버턴 1–0 at Old Trafford with a goal from 라이언 긱스 in their first match since the death of Sir 맷 버스비. The Steel City derby at Hillsborough sees 셰필드 웬즈데이 beat 셰필드 유나이티드 3–1.
A match at Upton Park sees 웨스트햄 유나이티드 draw 3–3 with 노리치 시티, who have scored 32 goals on their travels in the Premier League this season but just eight times at home.
A Brian Tinnion goal gives 브리스틀 시티 a 1–0 win over 리버풀 in the FA Cup third round replay.
맨체스터 유나이티드 reach the League Cup semi-finals for the third time in four seasons by beating 포츠머스 1–0 in the Fratton Park quarter-final replay.

Kidderminster Harriers claim another Football League scalp when they triumph 1–0 at home to 프레스턴 노스 엔드 in the FA Cup fourth round. Other surprise results include 맨체스터 시티's 1–0 defeat to Division Two strugglers 카디프 시티. Tranmere reach the League Cup semi-finals for the first time ever by beating 노팅엄 포리스트 2–0 in the quarter-final replay at Prenton Park .
맨체스터 유나이티드 keep their treble bid on track with a 2–0 win at 노리치 시티 in the FA Cup fourth round.

맨체스터 유나이티드 finish January as leaders with a 16-point margin, though 블랙번 로버스 in second place have three games in hand. 아스널, 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 and a resurgent 리버풀 side undaunted by the FA Cup shock and change of manager complete the top five. 스윈던 타운 remain bottom, while 올덤 애슬레틱 occupy the next lowest position, though 셰필드 유나이티드 have climbed out of the relegation zone at the expense of 맨체스터 시티. In Division One, 크리스털 팰리스 and 찰턴 애슬레틱 lead the race for promotion to the Premier League. The playoff zone is occupied by 밀월, 레스터 시티, 트랜미어 로버스 and 노팅엄 포리스트. 울버햄프턴 원더러스 are on the comeback trail after a run of dismal form before Christmas , and are now just two points and two places outside the playoff zone.
